items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you could see Wynton kind of uh chuckle

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Muhal. He came … well, see, they uh did it uh alphabetically so Muhal was first, and he had a very exciting, innovative piece. Oh man, it was dramatic because it was uh … you could see Wynton kind of uh chuckle he would cause because his approach was totally uh, uh different from most conductors, you know. He, he was, he started the piece and then he walked off stage lookin' at his watch as if he was gonna time uh how long they would play in his absence, which was a few minutes. And he came back. Well,…
You mentioned your family, obviously your mother has been a persistent thread … You played the piece last night, it’s on the 2009 album. Uh but, you haven't introduced us to your immediate family.
